text: Ironvale Athletic effectively capitalized on Redmond Rovers' high defensive line with a quick, direct counter-attack to level the score at 3-3 in the 86th minute. Their 5-3-2 low block absorbed pressure, allowing Jonah Lindqvist to deliver a short assist to Ilias Thorne, who scored from close range after a swift 6.9-second buildup [#1534] [#1537]. Redmond's high press and defensive positioning exposed space behind, which Ironvale exploited with vertical passing and fast transitions [#1532] [#1533]. Coaching takeaway: when deploying a high defensive line, ensure quicker recovery and tighter coordination to prevent opponents from exploiting counters in transitional moments.
